failures: The first fresh-isolate probe encountered previous-build pi responses during the treatment epochs after stateless health checks had passed. HTTP 409 build mismatches were observed directly and inside driver HTTP 502 responses. Failed inputs were not retried, subsequent inputs to affected Objects were skipped, and this incomplete run is excluded from performance claims.

The first fresh-isolate forced-read run completed three epochs (540 successful turns), then untimed padding preparation for epoch four returned HTTP 500 with an internal-error reference. The final 180 planned turns were not attempted. No CPU- or memory-limit outcome was observed. The underlying cause is not established; no input was retried. This incomplete run is excluded from performance claims.

failures: All four epochs finished, with 707 ok turns, four freshness exclusions, four failed turns and five skipped follow-ups. Four pi Objects returned HTTP 500 internal-error references, including one unpadded control; one error was wrapped by the driver as HTTP 502. The cause is unknown and no CPU- or memory-limit outcome was observed. No uncertain input was retried. Target cleanup was API-verified; the run is excluded from performance claims and an unchanged replication uses new Objects.
